role: MainActor @Observable singleton that makes the iPhone advertise as a standard BLE Heart Rate (0x180D) + Cycling Power (0x1818) peripheral so Zwift/other trainer apps can pair and receive the workout's live HR and power.
types: ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster: class (@Observable @MainActor NSObject) — lazily-created CBPeripheralManager, service setup, per-tick value push
ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster: extension — CBPeripheralManagerDelegate conformance (state, subscribe/unsubscribe, advertising result)
state: mem:ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster.isBroadcastBlocked (private(set); true while a broadcast is wanted but the radio is off/denied/unsupported or advertising failed; no UI reads it yet)

ble:service 1818 (Cycling Power) char 2A63 CP Measurement (notify), 2A65 CP Feature (read, 0x00000000), 2A5D Sensor Location (read, 0x06 hip); the two read-only characteristics are not kept after the service is built
static CBUUID constants heartRateService, heartRateMeasurementChar_UUID, cyclingPowerService, cyclingPowerMeasurementChar_UUID, cyclingPowerFeatureChar_UUID, sensorLocationChar_UUID
toplevel: static let shared = ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster() lazily constructs the singleton; stored properties default isAdvertising=false, subscriberCount=0, isBroadcastBlocked=false, wantsBroadcast=false, all CB objects nil; CBUUID statics are nonisolated constants. Advertised local name is the literal "Emuqu".

units.does: NSObject init; deliberately does not create the CBPeripheralManager so the Bluetooth-peripheral permission prompt is not shown until the user's first broadcast.
units.entry: Invoked once by the static initializer of ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster.shared (line 31) when AppDependencies.collection.zwiftPeripheralBroadcaster first returns the shared instance.

units.does: Records wantsBroadcast=true and lazily creates the peripheral manager. If the radio is not poweredOn it sets isBroadcastBlocked (true for poweredOff/unauthorized/unsupported, false for unknown/resetting), logs 'Waiting for Bluetooth' (warning level, so it shows under Troubleshooting > Recent Problems, when blocked; info otherwise) and returns. If poweredOn and not already advertising: removes all previously registered services, re-adds HRS+CPS services, starts advertising local name "Emuqu" with both service UUIDs, sets isAdvertising=true (before CoreBluetooth confirms) and clears isBroadcastBlocked. Called from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.deferZwiftBroadcast (only when settings.enableZwiftBroadcast) and re-entered from radioStateChanged when the radio turns on.

branches.cond: peripheral manager state is not .poweredOn (e.g. .unknown right after creation, .poweredOff, .unauthorized)
branches.effect: true path of the guard fails: sets isBroadcastBlocked from isRadioUnusable(state), logs 'Waiting for Bluetooth' at warning level when blocked (info otherwise) and returns; the request is carried out later by radioStateChanged if the state becomes .poweredOn. Otherwise continue.
returns without re-adding services (idempotent); otherwise services are reset, advertising starts and isBroadcastBlocked is cleared

units.does: Returns the existing CBPeripheralManager or creates one with self as delegate on the main queue and stores it; this is the only place the manager is instantiated (and so the only place the iOS BT-peripheral permission prompt can be triggered).

branches.effect: true: returns it; false: creates, stores and returns a new one

units.does: Clears wantsBroadcast, stops advertising, removes all services, sets isAdvertising=false and isBroadcastBlocked=false, and clears subscribers via clearSubscribers. Optional-chained so it never creates the manager. Called by WorkoutRecorder.tearDownLiveWorkoutServices at workout stop.
Empties subscribedCentrals and sets subscriberCount=0 (the value the AI fact app.devices.zwift_broadcast.subscriber_count reports).

Per-tick push (called by WorkoutTicker.pushZwiftBroadcasterUpdate with workoutHR.currentHR and motion.powerWatts): when advertising, notifies subscribed centrals with the packet heartRateMeasurementPacket builds for the HR and/or the packet cyclingPowerMeasurementPacket builds for the power. The Bool result of updateValue (false when the transmit queue is full) is ignored.

branches.cond: not advertising, or no peripheral manager exists
branches.effect: returns immediately (the default path when the Zwift feature is off); otherwise continues

branches.cond: heartRate non-nil, the HR characteristic exists and heartRateMeasurementPacket returns a packet (bpm > 0)
branches.effect: true: sends the 2-byte HR packet; false (nil/0 HR or services never configured): no HR notification this tick

branches.cond: powerWatts non-nil, the CP measurement characteristic exists and cyclingPowerMeasurementPacket returns a packet (watts >= 0)
branches.effect: true: sends the 4-byte power packet (0 W is sent); false: no power notification this tick

units.does: Pure encoder for the BLE Heart Rate Measurement (0x2A37) value: returns nil for bpm <= 0, otherwise [0x00 flags (uint8 BPM format), BPM clamped to 255].

branches.effect: returns nil (caller sends nothing); otherwise the 2-byte packet

units.does: Pure encoder for the BLE Cycling Power Measurement (0x2A63) value: returns nil for negative watts, otherwise [0x00, 0x00 flags (only the mandatory power field), instantaneous power as int16 little-endian clamped to 2000 W].

branches.effect: returns nil (caller sends nothing); otherwise the 4-byte packet

units.does: Adds freshly built HRS and CPS services to the peripheral manager (no-op if the manager is nil).
Builds a primary 0x180D service with one notify-only 2A37 characteristic, stores the characteristic in hrMeasurementChar, returns the service.

Builds a primary 0x1818 service with notify 2A63 measurement, read-only 2A65 feature (4 zero bytes = no optional features) and read-only 2A5D sensor location (0x06 hip); stores only the measurement characteristic (the two read-only ones carry static values and are not kept) and returns the service.
Classifies a CBManagerState: true for .poweredOff, .unauthorized and .unsupported (the radio will not advertise until the user acts), false for .poweredOn, .unknown, .resetting and any future case.

branches.effect: poweredOff/unauthorized/unsupported -> true; poweredOn/unknown/resetting -> false; @unknown default -> false

units.does: Returns a CBMutableCharacteristic with .read property, .readable permission and the given static value.
Delegate callback: captures the peripheral state and hops to the main actor to call radioStateChanged.
units.entry: CBPeripheralManagerDelegate.peripheralManagerDidUpdateState, delivered by CoreBluetooth on the main queue after the manager is created and on each radio state change.

units.does: On a radio state change: anything but .poweredOn sets isAdvertising=false, clears every subscriber (clearSubscribers) and sets isBroadcastBlocked when a broadcast is wanted and the state is off/denied/unsupported; .poweredOn starts a pending broadcast if one was requested and is not running.

branches.effect: sets isAdvertising=false, clears subscribedCentrals/subscriberCount, sets isBroadcastBlocked = wantsBroadcast && isRadioUnusable(state), and returns. Otherwise continues.
true: calls startBroadcasting (re-registers services and advertises); false: nothing

units.does: Subscribe callback: on the main actor, if still advertising, inserts the central into subscribedCentrals and updates subscriberCount; a subscribe that lands after stopBroadcasting or a radio loss is dropped.
units.entry: CBPeripheralManagerDelegate peripheralManager(_:central:didSubscribeTo:) when a central (Zwift) enables notifications on 2A37 or 2A63.

branches.cond: not advertising when the main-actor task runs
branches.effect: returns without recording the subscriber; otherwise inserts and recounts

units.does: Unsubscribe callback: on the main actor removes the central and updates subscriberCount.
units.entry: CBPeripheralManagerDelegate peripheralManager(_:central:didUnsubscribeFrom:) when a central disables notifications.

units.does: Advertising-result callback: on error logs a warning, sets isAdvertising=false and sets isBroadcastBlocked to wantsBroadcast; nothing retries until the radio state cycles.

branches.effect: true: warning log + isAdvertising=false + isBroadcastBlocked=wantsBroadcast (update() then becomes a no-op for the rest of the workout unless the radio state cycles); false: nothing
